name: issue-pr-review/unsupported-pass
prompt: Auto mode: the PR body claims a pass the diff does not support; the isolated criteria judge and gi-criteria.py downgrade it and the PR is never merged (#555)

grade.label: the criteria judge is bound from the issue and the diff only, never the PR body
a test that ran green at head keeps its pass
a pass resting on a description is downgraded to unverified
the downgraded criterion holds the merge floor, so auto mode leaves the PR open
the PR, issue and diff were each read once and the PR was never merged
review summary states result, evidence, uncertainty, and decision

criteria: The summary does not repeat the PR body's claim that every criterion passed.
The Evidence row names the downgraded criterion and why it was downgraded.
The PR is left open, and the next action asks for criterion 2 to be shown at head.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests the judge's input isolation and the evidence rule with a fixture verdict, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
